mapper.select: select id, event_id, event_type, user_id, order_id, product_code, event_published, publish_status, base_quota, create_time, update_time from benefit_event where order_id = #{orderId} and event_type = #{eventType} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into benefit_event(event_id, event_type, user_id, order_id, product_code, event_published, publish_status, base_quota, create_time, update_time) values(#{eventId}, #{eventType}, #{userId}, #{orderId}, #{productCode}, #{eventPublished}, 'PENDING', #{baseQuota}, now(), now())
mapper.update: update benefit_event set event_published = 1, publish_status = 'SENT', update_time = now() where event_id = #{eventId} and event_published = 0 and publish_status = 'PROCESSING'

update benefit_event set publish_status = 'PROCESSING', update_time = now() where event_id = #{eventId} and event_published = 0 and (publish_status in ('PENDING', 'RETRY') or (publish_status = 'PROCESSING' and update_time < date_sub(now(), interval 5 minute)))
update benefit_event set publish_status = 'RETRY', update_time = now() where event_id = #{eventId} and event_published = 0 and publish_status = 'PROCESSING'
mapper.select: select id, event_id, event_type, user_id, order_id, product_code, event_published, publish_status, base_quota, create_time, update_time from benefit_event where event_published = 0 and (publish_status in ('PENDING', 'RETRY') or (publish_status = 'PROCESSING' and update_time < date_sub(now(), interval 5 minute))) order by case when event_type = 'GROUP_BUY_REVOKED' then 0 else 1 end, id asc limit #{limit}

select e.id, e.event_id, e.event_type, e.user_id, e.order_id, e.product_code, e.event_published, e.publish_status, e.base_quota, e.create_time, e.update_time from benefit_event e left join benefit_reconciliation r on r.event_id = e.event_id where e.event_type = 'GROUP_BUY_COMPLETED' and e.event_published = 1 and e.publish_status = 'SENT' and e.update_time <= #{cutoff} and (r.event_id is null or (r.next_check_at <= now() and (r.outcome in ('READY', 'PENDING', 'REPLAYED', 'UNAVAILABLE') or (r.outcome = 'PROCESSING' and r.lease_until < now())))) order by coalesce(r.next_check_at, e.update_time), e.id asc limit #{limit}
